text: dsh-agent-menu 是面向 DSH Web 的精简右键菜单插件，为对话选区、链接、文件、代码块、图片和输入框提供复制或系统操作，并扩展工作区与会话侧栏菜单。会话菜单还能复制目录、打开位置或删除已关闭会话。它在 DSH desktop profile 中运行，不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-agent-menu adds right-click actions to DSH Web for selections, links, files, code, images, and the composer. It extends workspace and session menus with directory actions and deletion of closed sessions. It runs in a DSH desktop profile and needs no API key or external service.
想给 DSH 对话里的链接和文件加上复制地址、打开位置等右键操作。
如何从 DSH 代码块或选中文字快速复制内容？
I want context-menu actions for images and session folders in the DSH sidebar.
dsh-agent-menu 的功能「对话内容与图片右键操作」：在选区、链接、文件、代码块或图片上右键，可复制文本、链接或代码，打开文件位置或用默认应用打开，并复制或另存图片。图片字节操作由宿主路由处理。
dsh-agent-menu 的功能「侧栏工作区与会话目录操作」：扩展 DSH 原生工作区和会话菜单，提供复制目录、打开位置以及删除已关闭会话等操作；会话目录信息来自 DSH 的工作区/会话数据。
dsh-agent-menu 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 14 天；提交数 21；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 提供精简、克制的右键菜单。菜单只做复制、文件与系统操作，不插入 AI 提示词、不发送消息。

dsh-agent-menu README · 功能：| 右键位置 | 菜单项 |
| --- | --- |
| 对话中的选中文字 | 复制；若点中链接或文件，再显示对应操作 |
| 超链接 | 复制链接地址 / 复制为 Markdown 链接 / 在浏览器中打开 |
| 文件路径 | 复制路径 / 打开文件位置 / 用默认应用打开 |
| 代码块（未选中文字） | 复制代码 |
| 对话图片 | 复制图像 / 另存为…；本地图片另有打开位置、默认应用打开 |
| 输入框 | 剪切、复制、粘贴、撤销、重做、全选（按是否有选区显示） |
| 输入框图片 | 图片操作，以及从输入框移除 |
| 工作区行 | 保留原生重命名、删除；新建会话插在最上，复制目录、打开位置插在删除之前（删除工作区沉底） |
| 会话行 | 保留原生置顶、重命名、分叉、归档、复制会话 ID（就地汉化）；追加复制目录、打开位置、删除会话 |
| 其他位置 | 放行系统原生菜单 |

dsh-agent-menu README · 功能：- **工作区目录**来自官方 `workspaces.list` 快照；**会话目录**来自对应会话的 `cwd`，不会猜测路径。
- **删除会话**由本插件宿主路由 `POST /agent-menu/session-delete` 实现：删除 `~/.dsh/sessions` 下该会话的日志目录并清除归档标记。DSH 没有公开的会话删除接口，这是插件侧的等价做法；正在本应用打开的会话会被拒绝（409），等会话关闭或重启后再删。工作区删除仍使用官方对话框，会话会移到未分组。
- 工作区「新建会话」调用同一行已有的原生按钮；会话目录操作注册到官方 `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` 插槽，若该插槽在当前环境不渲染插件项，右键会话行时会就地 DOM 兜底追加「删除会话」并汉化复制项（两条路径不叠加）。工作区原生菜单目前没有对应插槽，追加项仅在确认是工作区原生菜单时出现。
- 相对文件路径必须能取得当前会话目录才会显示文件操作。图片的 `blob:` / `data:` 地址通过宿主字节路由复制或另存，不伪造本地路径。
- 菜单使用宿主主题色，卡片圆角 12px、菜单项圆角 6px，无图标、弱分隔线与轻阴影。工作区和会话的原生菜单保留 DSH 自身样式。

dsh-agent-menu README · 安装与更新：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xsllo425/dsh-agent-menu
```

从本地目录或 tarball 安装：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本目录或 tarball 路径>`。请替换为实际使用的 profile。安装或宿主代码更新后需要重启 DSH；不要仅为刷新客户端而反复重启。

dsh-agent-menu README · 与其他右键插件共存：- **dsh-file-menu**：本插件有对应菜单项时接管其已打开的菜单；没有菜单项时保留对方的菜单。
- **dsh-round-rightclick**：圆盘遮罩存在时让行。
- **dsh-session-deck**：侧栏右键在 window 捕获阶段阻止后续抢占，再触发原生按钮。
- 在判定菜单项和调用 `preventDefault()` 时发生异常，均放行原生菜单，避免出现「右键无反应」。

dsh-agent-menu README · 维护与验证：```bash
node --test tests/*.test.mjs          # 43 项，无任何依赖
node scripts/check-manifest.mjs       # 清单、导出、图标、文档一致性
```

`npm run verify` 一次跑完语法检查、全部测试和清单自检。

这些测试覆盖 DOM/服务桩、原生插槽注册和宿主路由；`tests/image-bytes.test.mjs` 会实际写入并读取系统剪贴板（仅 Windows，其他平台跳过）。它们不能代替真实 DSH 界面的浏览器验收。开发与边界记录见 [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)。发版流程见 [docs/RELEASE.md](docs/RELEASE.md)。

dsh-agent-menu README · 致谢：这个插件是在多个 AI 助手的协助下写成的。名单按本机会话记录整理（DSH、Claude Code、Codex 的会话里，实际改过本仓库文件的模型），按参与先后与多少排列：

- DeepSeek Flash
- SCNet-Max

A restrained right-click menu for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. It provides clipboard, file and native desktop actions without quoting content into the composer, sending AI messages or applying prompt templates.

dsh-agent-menu README · Menus：| Right-click target | Actions |
| --- | --- |
| Conversation selection | Copy; append link/file actions when applicable |
| Link | Copy URL / Copy as Markdown link / Open in browser |
| File path | Copy path / Reveal in file manager / Open with default app |
| Code block, no selection | Copy code |
| Conversation image | Copy image / Save as…; local images also support Reveal / Open |
| Composer | Standard Cut / Copy / Paste / Undo / Redo / Select all actions |
| Composer image | Image actions and Remove from composer |
| Workspace row | Native Rename/Delete kept; New session inserted first, Copy directory / Reveal inserted before Delete (Delete sinks to the bottom) |
| Session row | Native pin/rename/fork/archive/copy-session-ID (label localized in place), plus Copy directory / Reveal / Delete session |
| Anything else | Leave the native menu alone |

dsh-agent-menu README · Menus：- Workspace paths come from the official `workspaces.list` snapshot. Session paths come from that session's `cwd`; paths are never guessed.
- **Delete session** is implemented by this plugin's host route `POST /agent-menu/session-delete`: it removes the session's log directory under `~/.dsh/sessions` and clears its archive flag. DSH exposes no public session-deletion API, so this is the plugin-side equivalent; sessions currently open in the app are refused (409) — close or restart, then delete. Workspace deletion remains the official dialog, which moves its sessions to Ungrouped.
- Session additions use the official `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` slot and native `MenuItemButton`. If that slot does not render plugin items in the current environment, right-clicking a session row falls back to an in-place DOM append of "Delete session" plus the localized copy item (the two paths never stack). Workspace menus have no corresponding slot, so additions are made only after identifying the actual native workspace menu. New session invokes the existing native row button.
- Relative file operations are hidden when no authoritative session directory is ava

dsh-agent-menu README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xsllo425/dsh-agent-menu
```

From a local checkout or tarball, use `dsh plugin --profile desktop add <this directory or tarball>`. Use your actual profile. Restart DSH after installing or changing host code.

dsh-agent-menu README · Coexistence and failure behavior：- **dsh-file-menu**: take over its menu only when this plugin has applicable items; otherwise leave it alone.
- **dsh-round-rightclick**: yield while its overlay is present.
- **dsh-session-deck**: stop later sidebar context-menu handlers before invoking the native row button.
- Build menu items synchronously before `preventDefault()`. Empty results, stale generations and errors all release the native menu instead of leaving a silent right-click.

dsh-agent-menu README · Development checks：```bash
node --test tests/*.test.mjs          # 43 tests, no dependencies
node scripts/check-manifest.mjs       # manifest, exports, icon, docs
```

`npm run verify` runs the syntax checks, all tests and the manifest self-check in one go.

dsh-agent-menu README · Development checks：These cover DOM/service stubs, native slot registrations and host routes. `tests/image-bytes.test.mjs` writes and reads the real system clipboard (Windows only; skipped elsewhere). They do not replace browser acceptance in a live DSH UI. See [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) for implementation boundaries, [docs/RELEASE.md](docs/RELEASE.md) for the release checklist.

dsh-agent-menu README · Acknowledgments：This plugin was written with help from several AI assistants. The list comes from the local session logs (DSH, Claude Code and Codex sessions in which a model actually edited this repository), ordered by when and how much each took part:

- GLM (initial 0.1.0)
- MiniMax M3.1 Flash Preview
- StepFun Step-5 Preview
- Claude Sonnet 5.5
- Gemini 3.8 Flash
- DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
- Claude Opus 5.5
- DeepSeek Flash
- SCNet-Max
- Kimi K3.1 Pro

| 文件路径 | 复制路径 / 打开文件位置 / 用默认应用打开 |
| 代码块（未选中文字） | 复制代码 |
| 对话图片 | 复制图像 / 另存为…；本地图片另有打开位置、默认应用打开 |
| 输入框 | 剪切、复制、粘贴、撤销、重做、全选（按是否有选区显示） |
| 输入框图片 | 图片操作，以及从输入框移除 |
| 工作区行 | 保留原生重命名、删除；新建会话插在最上，复制目录、打开位置插在删除之前（删除工作区沉底） |
| 会话行 | 保留原生置顶、重命名、分叉、归档、复制会话 ID（就地汉化）；追加复制目录、打开位置、删除会话 |
| 其他位置 | 放行系统原生菜单 |

dsh-agent-menu README · 功能：- **工作区目录**来自官方 `workspaces.list` 快照；**会话目录**来自对应会话的 `cwd`，不会猜测路径。
- **删除会话**由本插件宿主路由 `POST /agent-menu/session-delete` 实现：删除 `~/.dsh/sessions` 下该会话的日志目录并清除归档标记。DSH 没有公开的会话删除接口，这是插件侧的等价做法；正在本应用打开的会话会被拒绝（409），等会话关闭或重启后再删。工作区删除仍使用官方对话框，会话会移到未分组。
- 工作区「新建会话」调用同一行已有的原生按钮；会话目录操作注册到官方 `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` 插槽，若该插槽在当前环境不渲染插件项，右键会话行时会就地 DOM 兜底追加「删除会话」并汉化复制项（两条路径不叠加）。工作区原生菜单目前没有对应插槽，追加项仅在确认是工作区原生菜单时出现。
- 相对文件路径必须能取得当前会话目录才会显示文件操作。图片的 `blob:` / `data:` 地址通过宿主字节路由复制或另存，不伪造本地路径。
- 菜单使用宿主主题色，卡片圆角 12px、菜单项圆角 6px，无图标、弱分隔线与轻阴影。工作区和会话的原生菜单保留 DSH 自身样式。

dsh-agent-menu README · 安装与更新：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xsllo425/dsh-agent-menu
```

从本地目录或 tarball 安装：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本目录或 tarball 路径>`。请替换为实际使用的 profile。安装或宿主代码更新后需要重启 DSH；不要仅为刷新客户端而反复重启。

dsh-agent-menu README · 与其他右键插件共存：- **dsh-file-menu**：本插件有对应菜单项时接管其已打开的菜单；没有菜单项时保留对方的菜单。
- **dsh-round-rightclick**：圆盘遮罩存在时让行。
- **dsh-session-deck**：侧栏右键在 window 捕获阶段阻止后续抢占，再触发原生按钮。
- 在判定菜单项和调用 `preventDefault()` 时发生异常，均放行原生菜单，避免出现「右键无反应」。

- 菜单使用宿主主题色，卡片圆角 12px、菜单项圆角 6px，无图标、弱分隔线与轻阴影。工作区和会话的原生菜单保留 DSH 自身样式。

A restrained right-click menu for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. It provides clipboard, file and native desktop actions without quoting content into the composer, sending AI messages or applying prompt templates.

dsh-agent-menu README · Menus：| Right-click target | Actions |
| --- | --- |
| Conversation selection | Copy; append link/file actions when applicable |
| Link | Copy URL / Copy as Markdown link / Open in browser |
| File path | Copy path / Reveal in file manager / Open with default app |
| Code block, no selection | Copy code |
| Conversation image | Copy image / Save as…; local images also support Reveal / Open |
| Composer | Standard Cut / Copy / Paste / Undo / Redo / Select all actions |
| Composer image | Image actions and Remove from composer |
| Workspace row | Native Rename/Delete kept; New session inserted first, Copy directory / Reveal inserted before Delete (Delete sinks to the bottom) |
| Session row | Native pin/rename/fork/archive/copy-session-ID (label localized in place), plus Copy directory / Reveal / Delete session |
| Anything else | Leave the native menu alone |

dsh-agent-menu README · Menus：- Workspace paths come from the official `workspaces.list` snapshot. Session paths come from that session's `cwd`; paths are never guessed.
- **Delete session** is implemented by this plugin's host route `POST /agent-menu/session-delete`: it removes the session's log directory under `~/.dsh/sessions` and clears its archive flag. DSH exposes no public session-deletion API, so this is the plugin-side equivalent; sessions currently open in the app are refused (409) — close or restart, then delete. Workspace deletion remains the official dialog, which moves its sessions to Ungrouped.
- Session additions use the official `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` slot and native `MenuItemButton`. If that slot does not render plugin items in the current environment, right-clicking a session row falls back to an in-place DOM append of "Delete session" plus the localized copy item (the two paths never stack). Workspace menus have no corresponding slot, so additions are made only after identifying the actual native workspace menu. New session invokes the existing native row button.

From a local checkout or tarball, use `dsh plugin --profile desktop add <this directory or tarball>`. Use your actual profile. Restart DSH after installing or changing host code.

dsh-agent-menu README · Coexistence and failure behavior：- **dsh-file-menu**: take over its menu only when this plugin has applicable items; otherwise leave it alone.
- **dsh-round-rightclick**: yield while its overlay is present.
- **dsh-session-deck**: stop later sidebar context-menu handlers before invoking the native row button.
- Build menu items synchronously before `preventDefault()`. Empty results, stale generations and errors all release the native menu instead of leaving a silent right-click.
